short_summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) moved from Hosted POC to Dedicated pilot negotiation. Focused on commit tiers, burst headroom, legal SOW for data residency and SSO/KMS integration. Finance wants guaranteed ramp schedule and hard overage cap for first 90 days.
deal_background: Peakline used Redwood Hosted for R&D POC; improved embedding recall and chat latency. Now pursuing Dedicated for production launch (support & personalization). Commercial talks centered on committed capacity + burst model and SOW redlines for VPC/KMS.
commercial_ask: Final ask: three-tier commit with explicit ramp schedule, burst pool with predictable pricing, overage hard cap, 6-week pilot followed by 12-month committed term. Wants a single SOW with tech appendix and a pricing workbook.
technical_requirements: SAML SSO, KMS integration for key management, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM, KV cache pinned in customer VPC, per-route token accounting, ability to pin model version and rollback during canary deploys.
negotiation_points: Commit size (12M vs 18M tokens/mo), burst multiplier & cost, overage cap vs overage price, ramp schedule credit/discount, SLA language around data residency and termination.
recent_feedback: Hosted POC = positive; ops + finance request predictability. Security team needs engineering confirmation on KMS + audit forwarding. Wants clearer example of month-by-month bill for ramp scenarios.
